feat(lexer): add opt-in extended export detection (#128)

The default matcher rejects parenthesized property descriptors generated by
webpack. Its unsafe-getter veto then suppresses declarations with the same
names.

This adds `parse(source, filename, { mode: 'extended' })` for broader
syntactic export detection. Extended mode accepts arbitrary object values
and descriptor bodies, skips simple leading comma operands, and recognizes
regex after labelled and switch case blocks. Its candidates can include
getters with side effects. Default detection remains frozen.

C and JavaScript retain separate scanners to preserve native Wasm scanning
and the standalone JavaScript build.
